import sys

def main():
    MOD = 1000000007
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    vis = [False] * p
    ans = p if k == 1 else 1
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not vis[i]:
            stack = [i]
            while stack:
                v = stack.pop()
                if not vis[v]:
                    vis[v] = True
                    stack.append((v * k) % p)
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
